about_variants:
I build AI systems with structured evaluation and verification.

ComicMainEngine: Generative comic pipeline using FastAPI backend with multi-provider LLM orchestration for script generation and image synthesis. Architecture uses VLM rubric gates to evaluate panel quality before output.

Procedural City: 3D city generation using LLM scene director with structured output validation. Architecture enforces schema constraints at each generation phase with budget ceiling enforcement.

BeamDojo: Humanoid locomotion using Isaac Lab with PPO training. Architecture integrates Isaac Sim physics with Weights and Biases experiment tracking for sim-to-real transfer.

Education: BTech CS from IIT Kharagpur, MS CS from UMass Amherst. Three years at Mastercard building payment APIs with latency optimization.

Looking for AI and agent engineer roles focused on evaluation-first development.
